whatChanged.theBuilder: scripts/build-census-v1-ak-tf800-set.mjs now passes suppressSynthesizedAppearances: true in its single finalizeOfficialForm call, with a comment naming the VF08 measurement it answers. That is the only change to this builder and the only change of any kind outside this family's regenerated artifacts.
whatChanged.whyTheOptionAloneIsEnoughHere: This builder hands finalizeOfficialForm the pinned source bytes themselves (sourceBytes: source.bytes). It performs no intermediate pdf-lib save of the source document before the shared finalizer runs, so the FIX57 pattern -- a neutralization save at pdf-lib's default updateFieldAppearances baking the square in before the finalizer is entered -- is absent, and no updateFieldAppearances: false repair was needed or made. Each of the four builders on this lane was read for that pattern and none of them carries it.
whatChanged.theSharedMachinery: Nothing in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs or scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs was edited. The option, its default of false, and its behaviour are exactly as FIX50 landed them; this lane only opts in.
whatChanged.whatTheOptionDoes: For a check-box or radio widget whose field this run did not write and whose current /AS state has no stream under /AP /N, an empty form XObject sized to the widget's own /Rect is installed for that state before updateFieldAppearances runs. pdf-lib then reports no update is needed and synthesizes nothing, so the square is never drawn and never flattened. The missing state is supplied rather than a drawing suppressed.
whatChanged.whatIsNeverTouched: A widget that already ships a stream for the state it is set to, a widget of a field this run wrote, a widget with no /AS, a widget whose /AP /N is a bare stream, and every text field, chooser and pushbutton. A ticked box still renders its mark from the stream the source ships.
whatChanged.whatDidNotChange: No default behaviour anywhere. No other family's builder, directory or bytes. No whitelist by family, form, field or route exists to change, and none was created. MASTER_QUEUE.json, RASTER_QUEUE.json, the legal-decision records, product-wiring.json and the claim ledger's other entries were not opened for writing.

rebuild.howProved: The whole family directory was copied aside after one build and compared with diff -r against the next. Zero differences across every file, twice: once over two --no-raster builds and once over two full builds that also regenerate the committed page rasters.

perWidgetMeasurement.method: Every page of both fixtures rastered with pdftoppm at 150 dpi, greyscale, before the edit and again from the committed bytes after it. The pinned source of every bound document was resolved by SHA-256 against the mounted Master Library and rastered the same way. Each selection widget's /Rect was mapped to pixels on the delivered page through that page's own CropBox, and read three ways: dark pixels before, dark pixels after, and dark pixels the pinned form paints there itself.
perWidgetMeasurement.whatClearedMeans: At that rect the delivered page after the repair is equal to the pinned form's own raster pixel for pixel -- pixelsDifferingFromPinnedSourceAfter is 0 -- so the page there carries the form's ink and nothing else.

noOtherPixelMoved.note: Zero. Every pixel that moved anywhere on any page of either fixture lies inside one of the measured widget rects.
noOtherPixelMoved.participantWritesAndIntendedMarks: Unchanged. Every participant write and every mark this run makes lies outside the measured rects, and no pixel outside those rects moved on any page; the widgets that ship their own state for the state they are set to were additionally read rect by rect and their ink is identical before and after.
